descriptor: Loud independent studio for brands and sites

voice.summary: Mono & Moss shouts on purpose, in short capitalised punches and verbs that start fights with boring design. It sounds like a studio that knows it is good and would rather be remembered than liked.
dos: Lead with a verb and cut every sentence to its loudest half
Pair one big claim with one small, dry joke
Name the work (brand, site, motion) before the adjective
donts: Do not whisper or hedge with maybe or perhaps
Never pad with corporate phrases like synergy or solutions
Avoid long paragraphs; stop at three lines

taglines: Designers, writers and engineers, turned up
boilerplate: Mono & Moss is an independent studio of designers, writers and engineers making identities, websites, motion, packaging and campaigns with a very loud voice.

microcopy.empty: No work here yet. Rude, we know.

logo.note: A spark stands for the loud idea, and it sits comfortably next to a lime highlight block.
